claims.verbatim:
Steamship Tarifa (Br.), Lawlands[?], Liverpool July 24, via Queens-
town 25th, with mdse. and 5[?]7 pass. to E. Cunard. July 25, off
Queenstown, passed steamship City of London, bound in; 26th, at
1:15 p. m., passed a National steamship, bound E; Aug. 3, at 11 a. m.,
passed schr. Billow Crest, bound E; 4th, at 5:30[?] a. m., passed ship[?]
Crescent City, bound W; 5th, at 11 a. m., passed steamship United
Kingdom, bound E; same day, at 4:30 p. m., passed an Inman steam-
ship, also one of Warren's line of steamers, both bound E.

Steamship Borussia (Hamb.), Schwensen, Hamburg July 18[?], and
Southampton the 18th[?], with mdse. and 541[?] pass. to Kunhardt & Co.
July 19[?], off Start Point, passed American steamship Star of Peace,
bound W.; off Landsend, steamship Bavaria, bound E.; 19th[?] inst., in
lat. 49 34[?], long. 12 21[?], ship Buffalo, from Quebec, bound E; 22d inst.,
in lat. 49 37[?], long. 28 30[?], steamship City of London, bound E; 25th[?]
in lat. 46 30[?], long. 50 24[?], bark Celeste Clark, bound W; 28th[?] inst., in
lat. 41 03[?], long. 65 25[?], ship Lewis, bound W, also the bark Orgasant[?],
bound W.

Steamship Helvetia (Br.), Ogilvie, Liverpool July 18, via Queens-
town 19th, with mdse. and 503 pass. to National Steam Navigation Co.
July 22, lat. 50 12, long. 25 42, passed steamship City of London, bound
E.; July 28, in lat. 42 22, long. 55 30, passed steamship Marathon,
bound E.
